name: MCH Ad Injector
author: macha795

sections.description:
MCH Ad Injector lets you place HTML ads at various positions in your WordPress site without editing theme files.

Features

  • Multiple ad insertion positions (before/after content, before H2 headings, comments, and more)
  • Page type and category/tag based display control
  • Scheduled ad delivery with start and end dates
  • Priority-based ad ordering
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/mch-ad-injector/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen
  3. Go to the MCH Ad Injector menu to create and manage your ads
sections.faq:
Ads are not displaying

Check that the ad status is set to Active and that the display conditions match the page you are viewing.

Can I exclude specific pages?

Yes. Each ad has settings to exclude by page, category, or tag.
